template.name: Octopus Nest
template.entry_long: close > bb_upper(close,{p0},{p1}) and ema(close,{p2}) > ema(close,50) and close > ema(close,20)
template.notes: The squeeze release is taken as a close above the Bollinger upper band with the documented EMA trend filter and price above the EMA; the Keltner/BB squeeze comparison needs a max() the DSL lacks and Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so both legs are dropped. Stops at recent extremes and the risk-reward target are not expressible.
